dialogue.content: こんばんは、どうぞよろしくお願い致します。
dialogue.English: Good evening. It's a pleasure to speak with you.

dialogue.content: こんばんは、よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Good evening. Thank you for having me.

dialogue.content: はい、宜しくお願い致します。時間前ですが、どういたしましょうか？
dialogue.English: Yes, it's a pleasure to speak with you as well. We're a little before our scheduled time. How would you like to proceed?

dialogue.content: 始めても大丈夫です。
dialogue.English: It's fine to start now.

dialogue.content: それでは、どうぞよろしくお願い致します。
dialogue.English: Alright then, let's begin.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 今日はどのようなご相談ですか
dialogue.English: What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: 3歳の娘が言うことを全然聞かなくて困っています。
dialogue.English: I'm having trouble with my three-year-old daughter who won't listen to me at all.

dialogue.content: 年代と、性別をお願い致します。
dialogue.English: May I ask your age range and gender, please?

dialogue.content: 30代、女性です。
dialogue.English: I'm a woman in my 30s.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Okay, thank you.

dialogue.content: 子供さんが、言うことを聞かないのですね
dialogue.English: So, your child isn't listening to you.

dialogue.content: はい、歯磨きするときになってからわざとおもちゃで遊びはじめて無視します。それでいて、こっちの様子も伺うんです。
dialogue.English: Yes, when it's time to brush her teeth, she'll deliberately start playing with her toys and ignore me. And yet, she's still watching me to see how I'll react.

dialogue.content: 一緒に考えていきたいので、もう少し詳しくお聞きしたいのですが、宜しいですか
dialogue.English: I'd like to work through this with you, so may I ask for a few more details?

dialogue.content: うん、うん、
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm, mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: そんな態度にイラつきますし、最初は優しく声かけしてるんですが、しまいには怒鳴ってしまいます。もう、疲れました。
dialogue.English: That kind of attitude irritates me, and although I start by speaking to her gently, I end up shouting. I'm just so tired.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。それは、つかれますね。家族構成をおききしても、宜しいですか
dialogue.English: I see. That must be exhausting. May I ask about your family structure?

dialogue.content: 夫、私、むすめです。
dialogue.English: It's my husband, me, and our daughter.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Okay, thank you.

dialogue.content: その時、夫さんは、側にいて、下さるのですか
dialogue.English: When that happens, is your husband there with you?

dialogue.content: 夫はほ仕事でとんど家には居ません。一生懸命作ったご飯が熱かった時に熱いって言われて、少し熱いくらいでそんなに…と、嫌なら食べなくていいって言ったら食べるーって、大泣きされてうるさかったです。嫌みな言い方になるのは自己嫌悪です。
dialogue.English: My husband is hardly ever home because of work. The other day, when a meal I worked hard to make was hot, she said, "It's hot!" and I thought, "It's just a little hot..." and told her, "If you don't want it, you don't have to eat it." Then she started wailing, "I'll eat it!" and it was so loud. I hate myself for speaking so sarcastically.

dialogue.content: 最近は、様子を伺うというかこちらの出方を見てるようなのが、癪にさわるし、心配でもあります。
dialogue.English: Lately, the way she seems to be testing me, or watching to see how I'll react, really gets under my skin, and it worries me too.

dialogue.content: 何度言っても聞かない時は、かなりきつく言ってしまいます。
dialogue.English: When she won't listen no matter how many times I tell her, I end up speaking very harshly.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。3さいでは、だんだん自我のめざめが発達してきて、だんだん言うことをきかなくなって来ますよね
dialogue.English: I understand. At three years old, their sense of self starts to develop, and they gradually stop listening to what they're told, don't they?

dialogue.content: 少しづつ、成長してきている明かしかも知れませんね！
dialogue.English: It might be a sign that she's growing up, little by little!

dialogue.content: 3さいでは、可愛い盛りですね。
dialogue.English: Three is such a darling age.

dialogue.content: 何でもかんでも嫌ーってなって疲れます。そうなんでしょうか。どんどん我が儘になっていくようです。少しこちらも緩めたときは、更に我が儘しほうだいで、きつく言わないとダメなのかなって思ったりしました。
dialogue.English: It's exhausting when she says "no" to everything. Is that really how it is? It feels like she's just getting more and more selfish. When I loosen up a little, she becomes even more self-indulgent, which makes me think maybe I have to be strict.

dialogue.content: うん、うん、
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm, mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 可愛いは可愛いんですが、いうこと聞かないと憎たらしくもなります。それで、意地悪なこと言ってしまいます。
dialogue.English: She is adorable, but when she doesn't listen I also find her infuriating. Then I end up saying mean things.

dialogue.content: とても大好きで大好きすぎて重いのかなって思ったこともあります。
dialogue.English: I've sometimes wondered if maybe I love her so much that it's overwhelming for her.

dialogue.content: お子さんは、ちゃんとせいちょうしていますよ！
dialogue.English: Your daughter is growing up just fine!

dialogue.content: 歯磨きの時も、ママと一緒にするとか、ママと一緒ならやりそうですね
dialogue.English: For brushing teeth, maybe if you do it together with her? It seems like she might do it if she's with you.

dialogue.content: 歯磨きはこれまでにも色々な手を尽くしたんですがダメでした。友達に娘の態度を言うと、「愛情が足りないんじゃないの？」と言われるのですが、親にはやり過ぎとか言われます。今までに1万冊の本を読んであげたりピアノを弾いてあげて歌を歌ったり、本人が嫌がらなければギューって毎日スキスキってしてるのに。これでも足りないなんて、分かりません。
dialogue.English: I've already tried everything for brushing her teeth, but nothing has worked. When I tell my friends about my daughter's behavior, they say, "Maybe you're not showing her enough love?" But my parents tell me I'm doing too much. I've read her 10,000 books, played the piano and sung songs for her, and as long as she doesn't mind, I hug her every day and tell her I love her. I don't understand how that could still not be enough.

dialogue.content: 歯磨きは、私がいつ怒り出すかをふざけながら探ってる感じで、おちょくられてます。
dialogue.English: With brushing her teeth, it feels like she's playfully testing me to see when I'll get angry. I feel like she's teasing me.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね！そんなに沢山素敵なことをしてあげられたのですね。すごいですね。
dialogue.English: I see! You've done so many wonderful things for her. That's amazing.

dialogue.content: とても、気が利いて賢いお子さんですね
dialogue.English: She sounds like a very perceptive and clever child.

dialogue.content: 沢山のことをしてきたのにこの結果ですから、何か間違ったのかもって思います。気が利くというのは何についてでしょうか？言うことを聞かないので、最後はいつも怒鳴ったり突き放したり、頭にきて小突いたりします。
dialogue.English: Even though I've done so much, this is the result, so I wonder if I did something wrong. What do you mean by perceptive? Since she doesn't listen, I always end up shouting, pushing her away, or even nudging her when I get angry.

dialogue.content: 我ながら、こんなにヒステリックで乱暴な母親だなんて、情けないです。
dialogue.English: I feel pathetic being such a hysterical and harsh mother.

dialogue.content: 赤ちゃんの時はこんなことにならなくて、幸せ一杯だったのに。
dialogue.English: It wasn't like this when she was a baby. I was so full of happiness then.

dialogue.content: もう、親の心を見抜いているようなそんな賢こい、お子さんです。
dialogue.English: She's a smart child, one who seems to see right through her parent's heart.

dialogue.content: 見抜いてるんですね。ただ、可愛らしくないですね。
dialogue.English: She sees right through me, huh. It's just not very cute.

dialogue.content: 丁度、3才から4才にかけて、自我のめざめが始まり、どこでも、てこずっていますよ。
dialogue.English: Right around ages three to four is when their sense of self starts to emerge, and every parent has a hard time with it.

dialogue.content: やるべきことをきちんとやって欲しいだけなのに、それすらやりません。
dialogue.English: I just want her to do what she's supposed to do properly, but she won't even do that.

dialogue.content: そんなもんなんでしょうか。もう、疲れてちょっと時間が空くと何もせずにボーッと立っています、私が。
dialogue.English: Is that just how it is? I'm so tired that whenever I have a spare moment, I just stand there spacing out.

dialogue.content: あまり、焦らずに、だれもが通る道だと思って、
dialogue.English: Try not to rush things. Think of it as a path that everyone goes down.

dialogue.content: きっと、娘さんのことばかり、考えていて、娘さんにとって窮屈な時もあるのかも知れませんね、
dialogue.English: You're probably always thinking about your daughter, and perhaps that feels restrictive to her at times.

dialogue.content: 窮屈ですか？
dialogue.English: Restrictive?

dialogue.content: ママ友とかと、遊びに行くとか、何か趣味を生かすとか？ママが楽しみを見つけてみては、
dialogue.English: What about going out with other mothers, or pursuing a hobby? Maybe you could try finding something you enjoy.

dialogue.content: コロナで公共施設の遊び場も人数制限の予約制だし、普段はお話しが大好きでずーっと話し相手をしないとだし、なかなか自分の時間も取れません。夏に越してきたばかりでまだ幼稚園も行ってないし、ママ友は居ません。
dialogue.English: Because of COVID, public playgrounds require reservations and have capacity limits. And she loves to talk, so I have to be her conversation partner all the time. It's hard to get any time for myself. We just moved here in the summer, she's not in kindergarten yet, and I don't have any "mom friends."

dialogue.content: 付き合いも煩わしくて、敢えてママ友を作ろうという気にはなれません。
dialogue.English: Socializing can be a hassle, so I don't really feel like actively trying to make mom friends.

dialogue.content: コロナで、制限されてしまって、思い切り、遊べないですね。
dialogue.English: With COVID, things are restricted, and it's difficult to play freely, isn't it?

dialogue.content: 実家など行けて、おじいちゃん、おばあちゃんと遊べると、良いのですが、近くはないのですか？
dialogue.English: It would be nice if you could go to your parents' house so she could play with her grandparents. Are they not nearby?

dialogue.content: はい、実家は飛行機でないと行けません。私の様子を伺うというのが、試してる感じの時もあるのですが、ガミガミ言い過ぎたせいもあるからか、恐れてるというか機嫌を気にしてる頃もあって、それで甘くしたら我が儘ばかりで…。
dialogue.English: No, my parents' house is a plane ride away. When she watches my reaction, sometimes it feels like she's testing me. But other times, maybe because I've nagged her too much, it seems like she's afraid or worried about my mood. But then when I'm lenient, she just gets more selfish...

dialogue.content: どうしたら良いのかが分かりません。最近は、優しく言っても聞かないから最後は怒鳴ってます。
dialogue.English: I don't know what to do. Lately, she won't listen even if I speak gently, so I end up shouting.

dialogue.content: 貴方が育つ時、お母さんにして頂いたように、やって見て下さい。きっと貴方のようにしっかり育ちますよ
dialogue.English: Please try to do for her what your mother did for you when you were growing up. I'm sure she will grow up to be a wonderful person, just like you.

dialogue.content: そうなると、止まらなくて腕を強く掴んだり、押し倒したりもしちゃうんです。なんだか、悪循環です。言うことを聞かない→厳しくする
dialogue.English: When that happens, I can't stop myself and end up grabbing her arm tightly or pushing her down. It feels like a vicious cycle: she doesn't listen → I get stricter.

dialogue.content: 母は厳しく私を育てたと思います。それに私も応えました。自分が悪いし、叩かれるのは嫌だったから。でも、3歳くらいの記憶はないです。
dialogue.English: I think my mother raised me strictly. And I responded to that. Because I knew I was in the wrong and I didn't want to be hit. But I don't have any memories from when I was around three.

dialogue.content: 娘は、言うことを聞かないので、私とは違うのかなと思いました。
dialogue.English: Since my daughter doesn't listen, I thought perhaps she is different from me.

dialogue.content: 私は厳しくしつけられたことに関して、感謝しています。その事によってできるようになったこと、身に付いたことが沢山ありますから。
dialogue.English: I'm grateful for being disciplined strictly. Because of it, there are many things I learned to do and skills I acquired.

dialogue.content: 娘が恥ずかしい子に育ったら私の責任です。
dialogue.English: If my daughter grows up to be a child I'm ashamed of, it will be my responsibility.

dialogue.content: 実家のお母さんに、小さい頃のことを聞いて見て下さい。同じようにてこずったかも知れませんね？たまにはお母さんの声を聞いて、心がほのぼのとします。
dialogue.English: Try asking your mother about what you were like when you were little. Maybe she had a hard time in the same way? Hearing your mother's voice now and then can be heartwarming.

dialogue.content: 子育てが疲れて、ママが倒れたら大変です。子供さんが、欲しくても出来ない方が沢山いるなかで、一人でも、授かったことに感謝して、
dialogue.English: If you become exhausted from parenting and collapse, that would be very hard. Among many people who want children but cannot have them, please feel grateful to have been blessed with even one.

dialogue.content: 私の育て方が悪いって言われそうで、ちょっと怖いですけど…聞いてみます。
dialogue.English: I'm a little scared she might say I'm a bad mother... but I'll try asking her.

dialogue.content: ママと呼んでもらえる幸せをもう一度噛み締めて見て下さい。きっと、今は言うことを聞いてくれないけど、直ぐに大きくなります。
dialogue.English: Please take a moment to savor the happiness of being called "Mama." I'm sure that even though she doesn't listen now, she'll grow up in the blink of an eye.

dialogue.content: 確かにアッという間に大きくなっていくんだろうなと思います。だからこそ、しっかりしつけたいし、それでいて笑顔のお母さんでいたいのに…。
dialogue.English: It's true, she will grow up in the blink of an eye. That is precisely why I want to discipline her properly, and yet still be a smiling mother…

dialogue.content: 両方できていないなんて…。
dialogue.English: But I can't seem to do either...

dialogue.content: 3才位の悩みより、これから、小学生、にはいり、もっと大変な悩みがでてくるかも、知れません。貴方はしっかり、子育てをされています。ただママに甘えているだけです。心配ありません。
dialogue.English: Compared to worries at age 3, there might be bigger challenges when she enters elementary school. You're doing a solid job with parenting. She's just being a little spoiled with her mom. There's no need to worry.

dialogue.content: うまくいってるのかどうか、誉められるようにできてるのかは分かりませんが、今は本当に娘忠心の生活ですね。
dialogue.English: I don't know if I'm doing a good job or if I'm doing things in a praiseworthy way, but my life really does revolve around my daughter right now.

dialogue.content: 可愛い盛りの子供さんのお話をまた、来て聞かせてくださいね。今日はお時間が来てしまいましたので、
dialogue.English: Please come again and tell me more stories about your adorable daughter. Our time is up for today.

dialogue.content: 忠心の → 中心の
dialogue.English: 'loyal' → I meant 'centered'.

dialogue.content: これで、大丈夫でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Is that alright?

dialogue.content: はい、有り難うございました。
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you very much.

dialogue.content: それでは、終了させて頂きます。合掌
dialogue.English: Then, we will conclude our session. Thank you.

dialogue.content: 3歳の可愛い部分も味わいたいと思いました。
dialogue.English: I realized I want to enjoy the cute parts of her being three years old, too.

dialogue.content: 良かったです
dialogue.English: I'm glad to hear that.
